# American Glass Experts Inc. — llms.txt
# https://www.americanglassexperts.us

## About
American Glass Experts Inc. is a licensed glass repair and installation contractor serving Los Angeles, Ventura, San Bernardino, and Riverside Counties in Southern California. C-17 Glazing Contractor License, CSLB #1125850.

## Services
- Frameless, semi-frameless, and framed shower enclosures
- Window repair and replacement (broken seals, foggy double-pane, cracked glass)
- Commercial storefronts (tempered panels, aluminum framing, glass doors)
- Custom mirrors (bathroom, closet, gym, wall)
- Glass partitions and table tops
- Emergency glass repair and board-up (break-ins, storm damage)

## Service Area
Primary: San Fernando Valley — Reseda, Woodland Hills, Northridge, Canoga Park, Chatsworth, Tarzana, Encino, Sherman Oaks, Studio City, Van Nuys, North Hollywood, Burbank, Glendale
Extended: Los Angeles County, Ventura County (Thousand Oaks, Simi Valley, Camarillo, Oxnard, Ventura), San Bernardino County, Riverside County
